facts.value: Manual: dial range reaches 5 to 7 mm; reverse stitch is always 5 mm when the dial is set between 5 and 7 mm. Maker page lists no stitch length. SMP spec copy lists Stitch Length: 5 mm.
facts.note: Our spec cites the maker page for 7 mm, but that page prints no stitch length. The 7 mm figure is only implied by the manual's '5-7 mm' dial wording; the dealer copy says 5 mm. Soft number: keep as disagreement.

site.label: Max stitch length
site.juki: Manual p10: dial set between 5 and 7 mm gives 5 mm reverse; no explicit maximum

facts.value: Maker wording: 'large 5.7" x 8.7" needle-to-arm space'; spec table: 'Workspace (H x W) 5.7" x 8.7"' on the dealer copy
facts.note: Maker calls it needle-to-arm space, so 8.7 in is the width claim. Sibling PQ1500SL maker page lists 5.7 x 8.6 in (needle to arm x front to back, per a Brother customer service answer in search snippet). Parts retailer figure of 8.5 in is not a maker figure.

facts.value: Wide table 11.1 x 23.3 in (283 x 593 mm), included

facts.value: Manual p20: 'HLX5 needles are recommended; however, Schmetz 130/705H needles may also be used under normal sewing conditions.' Carton lists needle sizes 9, 11, 14, 16 and one ballpoint.
facts.note: Spec is null and the briefing said needle system unpublished; the manual publishes it. Editor may fill needleSystem from the manual.

site.label: Needles

facts.value: Dealer copy of maker spec: 'Lighting: 1 Lamp'. Maker page does not list lighting type; manual mentions a light unit in safety text only.
facts.note: Type (LED or other) and brightness not published for the PQ1600S. PQ1500SL maker page says LED; do not carry it over.

facts.value: Push button thread cutter that automatically cuts upper and lower thread (maker main features)
facts.spec_value: Thread cutter (owner reports; Brother page lists automatic features)

site.juki: Push button thread cutter, cuts upper and lower thread

facts.value: Maker features: 'The needle position ... can be preprogrammed to be in the up or down position'. Manual p10: lit indicator means machine stops with needle lowered. Maker spec table row 'Needle Stop Position Up/Down: No' contradicts the feature text.
facts.note: Page-vs-page disagreement on the same maker page; the manual and feature text support a needle stop button.

facts.value: '1/2/25 Year Limited Warranty' (maker page and dealer page). Maker page gives no breakdown of which term covers labor, electrical or chassis.
facts.spec_value: 1 yr labor, 2 yr electrical, 25 yr chassis (1/2/25 limited)
facts.note: Maker wording is the three numbers only. The labor/electrical/chassis split in our spec is not on the maker page; a retailer page elsewhere describes a 25-year chassis term for some models. Sibling PQ1500SL page says '2/6/25 Year Premium Limited Warranty', so the warranty is model-specific. The maker's warranty-information page found is about extended warranties only.
